arStrings.szText: "Skull and Anchor's loads of fun, kid. But don't play it with any hot-tempered fellows. One time my roll came up all crowns, but as I round up my winnings, a giant fist shatters the whole damn table! Called me a cheater and took back the whole pot! That's why I gamble at the Fat Goose now." -Lyndon
Lock, stock, and two smokin' knuckles.
